summary: Examples of shell: redirecting output, chdir and creates via args, cmd with pipes, using bash for non-POSIX features, quoting variables, and running an expect script delegated to localhost.
questions: How do I pipe commands with the shell module?
How do I run an expect script inline with shell?
How do I safely pass a filename variable to shell?
How do I make a shell command idempotent with creates?

answer_card.title: shell examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.shell: somescript.sh >> somelog.txt
  args:
    chdir: somedir/
    creates: somelog.txt
- ansible.builtin.shell:
    cmd: ls -l | grep log
    chdir: somedir/
- ansible.builtin.shell: cat < /tmp/*txt
  args:
    executable: /bin/bash
- ansible.builtin.shell: cat {{ myfile|quote }}
```
Inline expect: pass the script as a block and set `executable: /usr/bin/expect`.
